fields.description: Issue published Saturday, July 7, 1928 ("Noue 5 umber 24"), with editorial and local commentary focused on Miami’s preparations for the forthcoming B.P.O.E. (Elks) convention and the city’s reliance on conventions and publicity. Includes a satirical "Guide to Miami" about nightlife and getting home from night clubs, discussion of city budget priorities (police/fire protection vs. publicity spending), notes on mosquitoes (including reports tied to Biscayne Key), and items on Prohibition enforcement and bootlegging. Contains letters to the editor regarding the Miami Police Department and public safety, along with local society/entertainment notices and advertisements.
